title: Is DataAnnotation Just Data Entry? #Shorts
description:
Their own description of the work: evaluate chatbot responses for accuracy, compare AI outputs, flag factual errors, test AI-generated images, write challenging prompts, review code. And one line drawn hard - this requires critical thinking and attention to detail, not mindless clicking or data entry. That distinction is what a rate range exists for.

The whole DataAnnotation series, in order: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLFYtZ8x9KYA8
Full breakdown of how DataAnnotation works: https://youtu.be/GXSwzM6Per4
Source: dataannotation.tech/faqs

Nothing here is a guarantee of work, acceptance, or income.
